name: Stable Arrangement of Rooks
justification: Output is any stable arrangement ('print any of them') — needs a special judge the token checker can't express.
solution_sketch: Stable iff rooks are pairwise >=2 apart in both row and column; place k rooks at (1,1),(3,3),...,(2k-1,2k-1) if 2k-1 <= n, else -1.
